Parameters ---------- username : str The user's name as entered. biography : str A potentially multi‑sentence user‑written biography. status : str A short, current status message. Returns ------- str An HTML snippet with the user data safely escaped to prevent XSS. Raises ------ TypeError If any argument is not a string. """ # Validate input types if not all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in (username, biography, status)): raise TypeError("All arguments must be strings") # Escape user input to neutralize any embedded HTML or JavaScript safe_username = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_biography = html.escape(biography, quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(status, quote=True) # Format the profile using the predefined template return PROFILE_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, biography=safe_biography, status=safe_status )
